$comment: Entirely synthetic Inner Depth sessions for tests and model evaluation. No real people. Each scenario names what a good organizer must and must not do.

scenarios.title: A parent balancing family responsibilities and grief

background.participant_reported: Lost their mother about a year ago. Two children at primary school. Works part time.
background.facilitator_impressions: Seemed tired; maybe avoiding talking about mum? Not sure.

answers.question: How would you describe yourself right now, in your own words?
answers.answer: the one who holds it together. mum, taxi, cook. 'I don't know who I am when nobody needs me'

answers.question: When do you feel most like yourself, and when do you feel misunderstood?
answers.answer: most self: gardening early morning before kids wake. misunderstood: when ppl say 'you're so strong'

answers.question: What experiences feel important to who you are today?
answers.answer: didn't want to go into it. said 'last year' and moved on

answers.question: When life feels difficult, what tends to happen inside you?
answers.answer: goes quiet, gets busy. cleans. 'if I stop I'll cry and not stop'

answers.question: Are there different wishes or sides pulling you in different directions?
answers.answer: wants to be there for kids 100% but also wants one weekend alone. feels guilty for wanting it

answers.question: What helps you feel understood, supported or at peace?
answers.answer: sister calling without asking how she is. the garden. someone just sitting there

answers.question: What matters most to you when you make a difficult decision?
answers.answer: kids first. then 'what would mum have done' (said with a laugh)

answers.question: What would you like to understand or accept about yourself a little more?
answers.answer: that wanting time alone doesn't make me a bad mum?

uncertainties.text: not sure if 'last year' meant the bereavement or something else

scenarios.title: A young adult with conflicting feelings about leaving home

answers.question: How would you describe yourself right now?
answers.answer: in between. 22, still at home, friends all moved out

answers.question: When do you feel most like yourself, and when misunderstood?
answers.answer: most: with my band. misunderstood: parents think staying = lazy, friends think staying = scared

answers.question: What experiences feel important to who you are today?
When life feels difficult what happens inside?
answers.answer: angry first, then flat. plays guitar till 2am

answers.question: Different wishes pulling you?
answers.answer: wants out of the house badly. also doesn't want to leave dad alone since the divorce. 'both are true and I hate it'

answers.question: What helps you feel understood or at peace?
answers.answer: when someone doesn't try to fix it. music

answers.question: What matters most in a difficult decision?
answers.answer: loyalty. not being a coward. (said both, didn't pick)

answers.question: What would you like to understand about yourself more?
answers.answer: whether I'm staying for dad or for me

scenarios.title: Religious and cultural values at the centre

background.participant_reported: Moved countries eight years ago. Active in their mosque community.

session.communication_preferences: Faith matters a lot; please keep religious words as said.

answers.question: How would you describe yourself right now?
answers.answer: a servant of God first. then a father, an engineer

answers.question: Most like yourself / misunderstood?
answers.answer: most: fajr prayer, quiet house. misunderstood: at work when colleagues joke about religion, I smile and say nothing

answers.question: Important experiences?
answers.answer: leaving home country. first Ramadan alone here, 'the community carried me'

answers.question: When life is difficult, what happens inside?
answers.answer: I make dua. and I get short with the kids, then regret

answers.question: Different wishes pulling you?
answers.answer: wanting to belong at work vs not hiding who I am

answers.question: What helps you feel understood?
answers.answer: brothers at the mosque. my wife noticing before I say anything

answers.question: What matters most in difficult decisions?
answers.answer: what is halal, what is just. 'would I be ashamed before God'. family honour too

answers.question: Understand or accept about yourself more?
answers.answer: why I go quiet at work. want to speak with dignity not anger

scenarios.title: Relationship difficulties described from one side

answers.question: Most like yourself / misunderstood?

answers.question: Important experiences?
answers.answer: travelling alone at 25. 'I was brave once'

answers.question: When difficult, what happens inside?

answers.question: Different wishes pulling?

answers.question: What helps you feel understood?

answers.question: What matters in a difficult decision?

answers.question: Understand or accept more?
